text.offer: Rook says, "The farmers out in the Flatlands can't get a crop in for the ants. Giant ones, chewing through everything that grows and biting anyone who stands in the way. They're slow, so they're good practice for a new blade. Kill ten of them."
text.progress: Rook says, "The Flatlands are south and east of Cor Noth. You'll find more ants up at the source of the river, too."
text.complete: Rook says, "Ten fewer mouths in the fields. The farmers will thank you, and you hit a little harder than you did this morning."
